header.title: Flash
header.description: A short burst of light over the content, triggered by the pointer. `variant` sets the shape of the flash, `trigger` when it appears and `origin` where it starts. With `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` no flashes are shown.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine the props and see the generated code. Click (or hover, depending on `trigger`) the block to see the flash.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: `burst` is a hot radial from the origin, `wash` an even veil over the whole surface and `bloom` a softer fill that still peaks in the center.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: With `origin="center"` the flash always starts in the middle; with `pointer`, at the exact point where the pointer went down.

image.title: Over an image
image.description: A `burst` with `origin="pointer"` and `intensity="lg"` over an image. The root has `overflow: hidden`, so the flash respects the `border-radius`.

triggers.title: Triggers
triggers.description: `click` flashes on pointer down, `hover` on enter, `press` repeats while held (following the pointer) and `always` loops from the center.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: `duration` is how long each flash lasts, in milliseconds. With `press` it also sets the repeat rate: every `max(160, duration × 0.7)` ms.

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: `intensity` is the peak opacity of the flash. It takes a token (`sm`, `md`, `lg`) or a number between `0` and `1`.

color.title: Colors
color.description: `color` tints the flash. It defaults to white (`var(--gem-palette-neutral-0)`); prefer host tokens.

asChild.title: asChild
asChild.description: With `asChild`, the effect is applied to the child without adding a `div`. Here, on a gem-system `Button` with `origin="pointer"`.

state.title: Paused and disabled
state.description: With `trigger="always"` to see it in action: `isPaused` freezes the running flash and `isDisabled` stops spawning new ones without blocking the content.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onFlash` fires when the first flash starts and `outFlash` when the last one finishes, with the cause in `event.reason`. The layer doesn't block interaction: the button still gets clicks.

header.title: Flash API
header.description: Reference for the props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types of `Flash`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples of each variant and trigger.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import it from `@gem-org/gemffects/flash` with its `flash.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts the attributes of HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> except color, and passes them to the root div (or to the child, with asChild). Pointer handlers you pass run before the effect's internal logic.

items.hidden: The flash layer has aria-hidden and pointer-events: none: it's decorative and doesn't block interaction with the child.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce flashes are hidden (animation: none, opacity: 0) and no new ones spawn.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion (or the gemfx-ignore-reduced-motion class on an ancestor) forces the animation. Only use it if the flash is essential.
items.photosensitive: Mind photosensitivity: with press and the default duration the flash repeats about 4.5 times per second, above the WCAG 2.3.1 limit of three flashes per second. Lower intensity, raise duration or avoid press and always on large surfaces.
items.pointerOnly: Flashes only respond to the pointer: the keyboard doesn't trigger them. Don't rely on them to communicate an action.
items.touch: They fire on touch screens by default (disabledOnTouch is false). Turn it on if the flash gets in the way while scrolling.
items.meaning: The flash is decoration: don't use it as the only confirmation of an action. Pair it with text or an ARIA attribute.

items.root: Root. `position: relative`, `overflow: hidden` and `contain: paint`, so the flash stays inside the edge.
items.surface: Wraps the child, below the layer.
items.layer: Absolute layer over the child that holds the flashes.
items.burst: Each flash. Uses `mix-blend-mode: plus-lighter` (`screen` in `wash`). Gets the `classNames.flash` class.

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: `duration`, `delay` and `intensity` are always written inline on the root: use the props to change them. `color` is only written inline when you pass the prop.

items.color: Flash color, on the root. Set by `color`; default `var(--gem-palette-neutral-0)`.
items.duration: Duration of each flash, on the root. Set by `duration`; default `320ms`.
items.delay: Delay before the flash, on the root. Set by `delay`; default `0ms`.
items.intensity: Peak opacity, on the root. Set by `intensity`; default `var(--gemfx-intensity-md)`.
items.position: Origin of each flash, on each `__burst`. Comes from the event with `origin="pointer"`, or the center.
items.size: Size of each flash, on each `__burst`. Computed from the surface size.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global variables Flash reads as defaults.

content.title: Content
content.description: Which content gets the flash and where the effect is mounted.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Shape, origin, color and intensity of the flash.

timing.title: Timing
timing.description: Duration and delay of each flash, in milliseconds.

state.title: Trigger and state
state.description: When the flash appears and how it's paused or turned off.

items.asChild: Applies the effect to the only child, without a wrapping `div`.
items.origin: Where it starts: `pointer` (the event point) or `center`. With `trigger="always"` it's always the center.
items.intensity: Peak opacity: a token or a number between `0` and `1`.
items.duration: Duration of each flash. With `press` it also sets the repeat rate.
items.trigger: `click` on pointer down, `hover` on enter, `press` repeats while held and `always` loops.
items.isActive: Allows new flashes. With `false` none spawn and `outFlash` gets `inactive`.
items.isDisabled: Skips new flashes; the child stays interactive. `outFlash` gets `disabled`.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Shows flashes even if the user prefers reduced motion. Only if essential.
items.onFlash: Fires when the first flash starts.
items.outFlash: Fires when the last flash finishes, on disable or on unmount.
items.style: Inline styles for the root. Merged with the `--gemfx-flash-*` variables.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
